blends.name: Cosmic Pixiel - Poster Artwork
blends.desc:
This is apart of the 3-piece set of "Cosmic Pixiel" blends, each time we release new blends, each shall come in a set of 3 exclusive Pixygon NFTs.
- The Cosmic Pixiel Poster Artwork
- The Cosmic Pixiel Faceplate
- The Cosmic Pixiel Skin Card

### Must be blended using 5 Drops of Imagination.

### "Pixiel can be seen looking off into the night sky, embracing the cosmos in the distance."

#### Play the Pixygonµ here: https://pixygon.io/pixygonmicro/

#### Get more Drops of Imagination here: https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixygon/drops/186842
